The '''WESTAR-18 bolt pistol''' was a model of a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and the predecessor to the [[WESTAR-34 blaster pistol/Legends|WESTAR-34 blaster pistol]] that was considered ancient by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. One such pistol was owned by [[Corso Riggs]], who gave it the name "[[Sparkles]]," like he did with all his weapons.
